summary: Fixed the build by rewriting the unreleased migrations 0012 (drop/recreate the elevation index, integer feet-to-metre rounding half away from zero) and 0013 (no concat_ws, which needs SQLite 3.44), updating the label view to metres, and correcting stratum.toml (collectors read as cp1252, deferred foreign keys for taxa and specimens, TS and SD basis codes mapped). A fresh build passes all checks, and a 1.6.0 copy upgrades to an identical schema and identical rows.
